newsitem.title: USA: MedImmune adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: MedImmune adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: MedImmune Inc said Thursday that it has adopted a stockholder rights plan designed to deter coercive takeover tactics and to prevent an acquiror from gaining control of the company without offering a fair price to all stockholders.
The company said that is not currently aware of any such effort to acquire it.

Under the plan, MedImmune said shareholders would be able to purchase its stock at one-half market value when anyone acquired 20 percent or more of the company's common stock, or attempted to do so, without the company's consent.
MedImmune is a biotechnology company focused on developing and marketing products for the prevention and treatment of infectious diseases and for use in transplantation medicine.
